gaps.description: Production DecisionService has no material provider; _material denies with503. Existing scripts supply synthetic material only.

MaterialWitness requires qualified atomic monotonic generations, including ABA and source reset. No production witness provider is composed; constant fixture generations or inferred hashes cannot replace it.
Production registry installs upload/shared-analysis and optionally admitted collection only. Policy evaluation, human decision and registered handoff are not installed executable handlers.
The generic registered-handoff worker branch is explicitly a local uncertainty double without transport; it does not establish real dispatch.

scope: No terminal states seeded, no authority fabricated, no Docker/app mutation, no external action/GitHub calls. Existing scoped decision/handoff/receiver tests remain valuable but cannot establish this missing continuous production path.
